title: Non-indentical BG values for identical settings on watch and phone
symptom: The user reports that when switching between a smartwatch (Finow Q1 Pro) and a phone (Sony Xperia Z5 Compact) used as collectors for the same Dexcom G5 transmitter, the BG values on the smartwatch differ significantly from those on the phone, despite identical settings.
fix: The thread suggests that to switch between devices, the old master should be set as follower (uncheck 'Be master for followers') and remove the transmitter from Bluetooth devices, while the new device should be set as master (check 'Be master for followers') and select the transmitter under hardware data source. Also ensure settings for G5 are tested on both devices.
settings_changed: Be master for followers → unchecked on old master
Be master for followers → checked on new master
evidence_quote: To do the switch between phones you have to setup phone 1 as the follower (xdrip+ Sync Follower) and uncheck option " Be master for followers", additional remove you G5 transmitter from Bluetooth devices connected to the phone as it can cause problems during phone 2 connections attempts to G5 . On phone 2 select G5 under hardware data source and check the option " Be master for followers".
